module.name: Manufacturing Substrate Regime Model
module.purpose: Structural framework for describing, calibrating, and managing extreme manufacturing systems through explicitly declared operating regimes, boundary semantics, and operator-mediated interactions — architecture-agnostic and domain-neutral.
